description: ImpAI builds (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_impai.c; the brain, impai_brain.c, impai_econ.c, impai_build.c): Comet Catcher with fixed starts, true line of sight, mapped, at Easy, so both branches of every handicap stub the economy reaches run each pass. Seat 0 is an idle human (ARM, StartPos1) with a Peewee on hold about 1100 world units south of seat 1's start (5184, 560); seat 1 is ImpAI (CORE, StartPos2, so the launch writes `seatai=1`) and seat 2 OTA AI (CORE, StartPos3) with two A.K.s on hold in the map's far corner (384, 384), about 8 620 from its start (5712, 7216). The `impai-eco` test group orders the Peewee onto seat 1's commander at GameTime 3900, so the on-hit commander purge's site (row 18) runs on ImpAI's branch, once seat 1's plant stands with a constructor queued: the commander fires its 400-energy D-gun at the Peewee on its own, and a shot before then puts the store under the stall line ahead of the plant (tagpu/ddraw/tests/impai_brain_test.c, EGAME_PEEWEE). The Peewee cannot kill the commander: the Peewee's EMG does 8 a shot every 0.4 s, and its range, 180, is inside the CORE commander's laser's 200, which ends it in four shots (the retail FBIs and weapons.tdf). Nothing attacks seat 2: a stock AI commander that is hit drops its orders and pauses its builder planner 30 to 329 ticks a hit (0x406F80), so a Flea's beam every 0.8 s kept seat 2 from giving any order from GameTime 1212 to the end (MEASURED 2026-11-12, the recording's order lists). Its A.K.s make its orders and the takeover's moves hold by construction (tools/replay/fixtures.json takes the group over at 391, so its window is [391, 2191)): the attack planner 0x4077E0 orders one to three armed mobile units home every 300 ticks whatever the economy, home being the mean position 0x407410 of the seat's armed structures, else its other structures, else its builders (engine/orders.md, the force planners); the A.K.s are in group 3 by GameTime 32 (the group assignment 0x408830, every 30 AI ticks) and ordered home within the planner's next 300, by 332. By 2191 they have walked at most 1.72 x 2191 = 3 769 (CORAK's maxvelocity), and every seat 2 structure stands within a ground builder's reach of its start, at most 1.3 x 2191 + 60 + 91 = 3 000 (CORCV's maxvelocity, the fastest ground builder seat 2 can field by then: CORCH, 2.1, needs a CORHP, 19 005 / 300 s of the commander's workertime, and then 11 028 / 500 s, past 2191; CORCOM's builddistance; half an 8 x 8 footprint's diagonal), so home stays more than 1 800 from them throughout the window and they walk through it: two of the four mobile units the computer seats can hold at 391, the two commanders and these, since no plant of CORE's finishes before 670 (CORVP: 6 700 / 300 a second of its only builder's workertime). The bound does not cover an air constructor, which could carry a structure farther: CORCA needs a CORAP, 7 180 / 300 s, and then 9 286 / 400 s with the commander helping, so from GameTime 1414. Comet Catcher has 3 to 7 metal spots within 1024 of each of its first four starts and a wind of 10..15 (scout I11), so the extractors come from spots and the energy from solar.
